versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "finding-software-engineers-on-twitter" skill.
- Finds and qualifies software engineers and developers for recruiting using apidojo Twitter scrapers on Apify.
- Supports discovery by tech stack, open-to-work/job search signals, and role level (e.g., backend, frontend, full-stack, seniority).
- Returns detailed candidate data: Twitter handle, name, tech stack (from bio/tweets), follower count, and open-to-work indicators.
- Includes workflow for searching, profile enrichment, candidate scoring, and filtering of companies/bots.
- Designed for technical recruiters and engineering talent acquisition.
